now.title: Cloak & Dagger
now.text: Adina and Otis are married and still grieving their son Billy. They live apart for a time, but are back together when Tyrone is cleared.

proposed.text: Adina and Otis are married and still grieving their son Billy.

split.title: Cloak & Dagger#11
split.text: With Tyrone on the run, Adina and Otis have separated and live apart.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Adina's husband, Tyrone's father, now living apart from her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Otis's wife, Tyrone's mother, now living apart from him.

split.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
split.text: Adina and Otis are back together, watching the news that will clear Tyrone's name.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at episode 1 but tells the separation and reunion. Tyrone first finds his parents separated in S2#1 (#11, 'Restless Energy'); they reconcile and watch the Henderson arrest report together in S2#10 (#20, 'Level Up').

now.title: Cloak & Dagger
now.text: Melissa is Tandy's mother, struggling with addiction and grief. Their bond improves, and when Tandy leaves town Melissa sees her off.

proposed.text: Melissa is Tandy's mother, struggling with addiction and grief.

split.title: Cloak & Dagger#11
split.text: Back living with Melissa, Tandy works on their bond, and they go to a support group together.

split.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
split.text: When Tandy leaves town, Melissa sees her off.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Tandy's mother, who sees her off.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at episode 1 but tells the improved bond (S2#1, #11 'Restless Energy': Tandy has an improved relationship with her mother and they attend a support group) and Melissa seeing Tandy off (S2#10, #20 'Level Up').

now.title: Cloak & Dagger
now.text: Tandy and Tyrone were both caught in the night of the Roxxon rig explosion, and meeting again wakes their powers. As the Divine Pairing they become best friends, save New Orleans, defeat Andre and leave town together to be heroes.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Tandy's best friend and other half in the Divine Pairing.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Tyrone's best friend and other half in the Divine Pairing.

proposed.text: Tandy and Tyrone were both caught in the night of the Roxxon rig explosion, and meeting again wakes their powers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The boy from the night of the rig explosion, whose touch wakes Tandy's powers.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The girl from the night of the rig explosion, whose touch wakes Tyrone's powers.

split.title: Cloak & Dagger#10
split.text: Evita tells Tandy and Tyrone they are the Divine Pairing, and together they absorb the leaking energy at the Roxxon facility and save New Orleans.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Tandy's other half in the Divine Pairing.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tyrone's other half in the Divine Pairing.

split.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
split.text: Tandy and Tyrone defeat Andre for good, then leave New Orleans together to be heroes.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Tandy's best friend and other half in the Divine Pairing.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tyrone's best friend and other half in the Divine Pairing.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at episode 1 (they meet at the party and their powers wake), but tells the Divine Pairing, saving the city (#10 'Colony Collapse', where Evita tells them their fate), and defeating Andre and leaving town together (#20 'Level Up'). The card lines also name the Divine Pairing, which Evita first ties to Tandy in #9 and tells them in #10.

now.title: Cloak & Dagger
now.text: Evita is Tyrone's classmate, and she invites him to a party.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Tyrone's classmate, who invites him to a party.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Evita's classmate, whom she invites to a party.

split.title: Cloak & Dagger#3
split.text: Evita takes Tyrone to her aunt for guidance, and on a walk afterward they share a kiss.

changes.evidence: At episode 1 Evita is only a classmate who invites Tyrone to the victory party. They grow closer and share a first kiss in #3 ('Stained Glass'), and she is his girlfriend by #5 ('Princeton Offense').

now.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
now.text: Andre kills Chantelle, and Evita takes on her work.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Evita's late aunt, a voodoo priestess whose work she takes on.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Chantelle's niece, who takes on her work.

proposed.text: Evita learns that Chantelle is dead and becomes a mambo in her place, taking over her voodoo shop.

changes.evidence: Andre stops Chantelle's heart in #17 ('Vikingtown Sound'). In #18 ('Two Player') Evita has a vision of her aunt, understands she is dead, marries a Loa to become a mambo, and takes Chantelle's place running Damballah Voodoo Tours & Shop.
